title: Chinta Mani Library v2.3.0 Update (Build 24)
releaseNotes: Premium Dashboard: Luxury library background with refined muted gold card styling
WhatsApp Hub: Settings tab removed — now 3 focused tabs (Auto Bot, Broadcast, Students)
WhatsApp Config: Link WhatsApp number in App Settings instead of WhatsApp screen
Due Alert: Refined alert banner to deep burgundy/wine palette (was amber/orange)
Theme Customization removed: Fixed premium design identity — no more theme switching
Card Polish: Softer gold borders, reduced shimmer, warm ivory text on all metric cards
Navigation Cleanup: Drawer and More screen no longer show 'Customize App Theme'
